note: w7 The Whole World by image to 3D. Pictures 1 to 6 landmarks (--grid 1x1); 7 to 12 are 2x2 sheets. Its 28 seaside kinds (boats, crane, lighthouse, beach things) come from the w5 doc and keep that model. Cut with sheetcut.py --tol 18 --holes 8 (grey things at --tol 10 --holes 0).

doc.blurb: a whole little planet of countryside, towns and landmarks rolled up into one ball
doc.style: chunky rounded miniatures like pieces from a model railway village, with soft bevelled edges, matte painted plaster, stone and wood in gentle country colours (meadow green, slate grey, brick red, cream and a little gold), soft even light from the upper left, clean simple shapes. Thin parts drawn chunky: thick poles, cables and legs, and only a few of them.
